description: Run a Prometheus range query through a datasource, returning the result matrix.

datasourceUid.description: The uid of the Prometheus datasource to query through.

end.description: Optional end of the query time range, as accepted by the Prometheus query_range API; defaults to 'now' when omitted.

expr.description: The PromQL expression to evaluate over the time range.

start.description: Optional start of the query time range, as accepted by the Prometheus query_range API; defaults to 'now-1h' when omitted.

step.description: Optional query resolution step width, as a Prometheus duration string such as '15s' or '1m'; defaults to '15s' when omitted.

name: query_prometheus
